name: Basilica of Bom Jesus, Old Goa
path: Basilica of Bom Jesus, Old Goa, North Goa, India
summary: 16th-century Jesuit Baroque church enshrining the sacred relics of St. Francis Xavier.
points: Constructed between 1594 and 1605 CE; UNESCO World Heritage Site
Houses the mortal body of Saint Francis Xavier in a silver casket crafted by 17th-century Florentine silversmiths

name: Shanta Durga Temple, Kavlem
path: Shanta Durga Temple, Kavlem, South Goa, India
summary: Premier Hindu temple of Goa dedicated to the peaceful mediator form of Goddess Durga.
points: Constructed in 1738 CE during the reign of Maratha ruler Chhatrapati Shahu of Satara
Distinctive Goan temple architecture combining traditional Hindu pyramidal shikharas with Portuguese arched windows and Deepastambha lamp tower
